note: Hand-written owner problems for measuring discovery. 'expect' = capabilities that must be identified as needs; 'acceptTop3' = at least one of these tools should appear in the top 3; 'expectGap' = need with no catalogue tool; 'expectClarification' = Q9 must be asked. Written before tuning against results; wording varies on purpose.

cases.problem: I miss customer calls while working outside and need them answered and appointments booked.
When I'm up on a roof the phone rings and I lose the job to whoever picks up first.
We can't answer the phone during the lunch rush and people want to book a table.
After hours calls go to voicemail and nobody calls back the next day.
Customers keep asking the same questions on my website about shipping and returns.
Where is my order emails take hours every day to answer.
My salon gets lots of Instagram DMs asking for prices and I can't reply fast enough.
Customer inquiries get lost and I want automatic responses.
I never know what to post on Instagram and Facebook for the cafe.
I want to schedule posts for the whole month so I stop forgetting to post.
My product photos look amateur and I need clean backgrounds for my online store.
I'd like short videos and reels of our dishes for TikTok.
Nobody can find my firm on Google; I want to rank higher in search.
I need better Facebook ads and ad creative that actually converts.
I want to send a monthly newsletter and bring customers back with promotional emails.
Writing menu descriptions and promotion text takes me forever.
I spend client meetings taking notes instead of listening.
I'm overwhelmed with tasks and my calendar is a mess.
My emails to clients don't sound professional and I keep making grammar mistakes.
I copy and paste job details between apps all day; I want to automate the data entry.
I forget to follow up on quotes and lose jobs.
I need to find new clients and do outreach to local businesses.
My bookkeeping is always behind and reconciling the books takes weekends.
I have a shoebox of receipts and expense paperwork I never enter.
Paying supplier invoices on time is chaos.
I overorder ingredients and throw away food each week.
We got two bad reviews on Yelp and I don't know how to respond.
Planning routes and dispatching my crews wastes hours of driving time.
I don't want a chatbot, I just need help with my books and receipts.
Customers call while I'm on jobs and the inquiries get lost; I want automatic responses.
